core: Scavenger receptor efferocytosis and hyaluronan clearance
qualifier: immune complex clearance, without lysosomal processing
name: Scavenger receptor efferocytosis, immune complex and hyaluronan clearance
rationale: Members are class A/B/F/H scavenger receptors, apoptotic cell recognition and engulfment, neutrophil and immune complex clearance, RAGE and hyaluronan turnover; unlike its superset it lacks lysosomal and cholesterol-storage members, and unlike microglial/oxLDL neighbours it carries hyaluronan and immune complex clearance.

name: Scavenger receptor efferocytosis with lysosomal processing and cholesterol storage
rationale: Shares scavenger receptor and apoptotic cell/hyaluronan clearance with its subset but adds lysosome organization, lysosomal/endosomal proteins, protein import and cholesterol storage, which the subset lacks.

qualifier: neurotransmitter-specific release cycles, positive regulation only
name: Synaptic vesicle docking and priming in neurotransmitter release cycles
rationale: All members cover vesicle docking, priming, SNARE assembly and the acetylcholine/monoamine/glutamate release cycles with positive calcium-dependent exocytosis; it lacks the negative regulation and presynaptic modulation of its superset and the recycling/endocytosis of other neighbours.

name: Calcium-triggered neurotransmitter release with inhibitory presynaptic modulation
rationale: Contains the docking/priming release cycles plus negative regulation of calcium-dependent and synaptic vesicle exocytosis and presynaptic modulation, which distinguish it from its subset that only has the release machinery.

name: Malate-aspartate shuttle coupled to TCA cycle and pyruvate turnover
rationale: Members are the TCA cycle, malate/oxaloacetate/2-oxoglutarate metabolism, the malate-aspartate shuttle with aspartate metabolism and pyruvate transport/synthesis/catabolism; it lacks the succinate dehydrogenase and ATP synthase members of its superset and the PDH/CoA and carboxylate transporter members of other neighbours.

name: TCA cycle coupled to succinate oxidation and ATP synthesis
rationale: Includes the TCA/malate-aspartate shuttle/pyruvate core plus succinate metabolism, complex II electron transport and proton-motive ATP synthesis, which its subset lacks.

name: TCR-CD28 signaling and co-inhibition with second messenger generation
rationale: Members cover CD3/ZAP-70 proximal TCR signaling, CD28 costimulation, CTLA4/BTLA co-inhibition and IL-2 production, and add generation of second messengers and T cell activation signaling absent from the smaller core theme, while lacking the ITK/PKC differentiation members of the larger theme.

name: TCR costimulation, co-inhibition and ITK-PKC-driven T cell differentiation
rationale: Contains the full TCR/CD28/CTLA4/BTLA signaling set plus ITK/PKC differentiation, RHOH, IL2/IL7 network and CD8 and gamma-delta T cell differentiation, which none of its signaling-only neighbours include.

name: Proximal TCR-CD28 signaling with CTLA4 and BTLA co-inhibition
rationale: Members are CD3 zeta phosphorylation, ZAP-70 translocation, downstream TCR and CD28 PI3K/Vav1 signaling and CTLA4/BTLA co-inhibition, without the second-messenger, Nef or differentiation members of its supersets and without B cell receptor members of another neighbour.

name: Cytosolic and mitochondrial tRNA charging with anticodon-loop modification
rationale: All members concern cytosolic and mitochondrial tRNA aminoacylation, t6A and wobble modifications and translational fidelity; it lacks the selenocysteine, readthrough and tRNA splicing members of its superset.

name: tRNA charging and anticodon modification with selenocysteine recoding
rationale: Contains the aminoacylation and anticodon modification core plus selenocysteine synthesis, translational readthrough and tRNA intron cleavage, which the smaller fidelity theme lacks.

qualifier: resting potential in nociceptive and thermal detection
name: K2P channels setting resting potential in nociceptive and thermal detection
rationale: Members are TASK/TWIK/THIK/TREK/TRESK channels, resting membrane potential and detection of thermal and mechanical pain stimuli; it lacks the TALK, itch and fever members of its superset.

name: Two-pore-domain potassium channels in pain, itch and fever
rationale: Adds TALK channels, sensory perception of itch, fever generation and neuronal action potential regulation to the K2P/pain core, distinguishing it from the smaller pain-only theme.

qualifier: broad panel including dasatinib, nilotinib, masitinib, sorafenib
name: KIT mutant resistance across broad TKI panel including dasatinib
rationale: All members are KIT mutant TKI binding or resistance; beyond imatinib, sunitinib and regorafenib it includes dasatinib, nilotinib, masitinib and sorafenib resistance, which the smaller KIT theme lacks.

name: KIT mutant resistance to imatinib, sunitinib and regorafenib
rationale: Members are KIT mutant TKI binding plus resistance to imatinib, sunitinib and regorafenib only, lacking the dasatinib/nilotinib/masitinib/sorafenib members of the larger KIT theme.

core: Ubiquitin-dependent endocytosis and MVB sorting of ERBB receptors
name: Clathrin- and ubiquitin-mediated internalization and MVB sorting of ERBB receptors
rationale: Members cover EGFR/ERBB2-3/ERBB4 downregulation, ubiquitin-dependent endocytosis, MVB-to-vacuole sorting, the clathrin-internalisation module and InlB entry; it lacks the nuclear ERBB4 and PTEN stability members of its superset and the general ESCRT membrane-fission members of other neighbours.

qualifier: nuclear ERBB4 signaling and PTEN regulation
name: ERBB endocytic downregulation with nuclear ERBB4 signaling and PTEN regulation
rationale: Shares ubiquitin-dependent ERBB internalisation and degradation with its subset but adds nuclear signaling by ERBB4, PTEN stability and activity, and protein autophosphorylation.

name: Ubiquitin-proteasome system with deubiquitinases and selective autophagy
rationale: Members span ubiquitin activation and chain types, proteasome assembly, multiple DUB families, ERAD, misfolded protein quality control and aggrephagy, chaperone-mediated and microautophagy; the DUB families and autophagy routes distinguish it from its degradation-focused subset and folding/neddylation neighbours.

qualifier: degron and atypical ubiquitin chain targeting
name: Degron- and atypical-ubiquitin-directed proteasomal turnover of misfolded proteins
rationale: Members are proteasome, K6/K11/K27/K29 and branched ubiquitination, N- and C-degron pathways, ERAD regulation and misfolded protein response; it lacks the broad DUB families and autophagy routes of its superset.

core: Vascular smooth muscle cell phenotypic control
name: Vascular smooth muscle proliferation, migration, apoptosis and differentiation control
rationale: All members regulate vascular smooth muscle cell proliferation, migration, apoptosis, differentiation, dedifferentiation and phenotypic switching; it lacks the endothelial activation, matrix adhesion and aorta morphogenesis of its superset and the cardiac muscle members of another neighbour.

name: Smooth muscle phenotype switching with endothelial activation and matrix adhesion
rationale: Contains the VSMC fate-control core plus endothelial cell activation, smooth muscle cell-matrix adhesion and aorta smooth muscle morphogenesis, which its subset lacks.

core: Enveloped virus entry and protein maturation
name: Enveloped virus entry and maturation with host junction targeting
rationale: Members cover attachment, entry, protein maturation and assembly of SARS-CoV, dengue, RSV, influenza and HIV, plus SARS targeting of PDZ junction proteins and host signaling, dengue apoptosis modulation and host suppression of invasion, which its subset lacks.

core: Enveloped virus entry and protein maturation
name: Enveloped virus receptor-mediated entry, protein maturation and budding
rationale: All members concern receptor-mediated attachment and endocytic entry, structural/replicase protein maturation and assembly at budding sites for enveloped viruses; it lacks the host junction-targeting and apoptosis members of its superset and the replication/translation members of other neighbours.

core: Vitamin K gamma-carboxylation and ascorbate metabolism
qualifier: vitamin K catabolism and F9 carboxylation defect
name: Vitamin K catabolism and gamma-carboxylation with ascorbate metabolism
rationale: Members cover vitamin K metabolism and gamma-carboxylated protein processing, vitamin C metabolism and vitamin E response, plus menaquinone/vitamin K catabolism and defective F9 carboxylation, which its subset lacks.

core: Gamma-carboxylated protein processing and ascorbate metabolism
qualifier: vitamin E response, without vitamin K catabolism
name: Gamma-carboxylated protein processing alongside ascorbate and vitamin E responses
rationale: Members are vitamin K-dependent carboxylation, propeptide removal and ER-Golgi transport with ascorbate metabolism and vitamin C/E responses; it lacks the vitamin K catabolism and F9 defect of its superset and the redox/selenium members of another neighbour.
